isotomics.organizeData¶

isotomics.organizeData.create_nested_folders(fragment_dict, parent_folder='.')¶

Create nested folders based on a dictionary.

Parameters: - fragment_dict: A dictionary where keys represent folder names. - parent_folder: The parent folder where the structure will be created. Default is the current directory.

isotomics.organizeData.get_file_paths_in_subfolders(folder_path, file_extensions='.isox')¶

Recursively collects paths of files with specified extensions within subfolders of the specified folder.

Parameters: - folder_path: A string representing the path to the main folder. - file_extensions: A list of strings representing the desired file extensions (e.g., [‘.txt’, ‘.csv’]).

If None, all files will be included.

Returns: - A dictionary where keys are subfolder names and values are lists of file paths.

isotomics.organizeData.get_subfolder_paths(folder_path)¶

Get a list of paths of subfolders within a folder.

Parameters: - folder_path: A string representing the path to the main folder.

Returns: - A list of strings representing the paths of subfolders within the main folder.
